purpose: Correct the confirmed REG.RU self-hosted runner bootstrap defects: the official dependency installer requires root authority before ownership transfer, while repeated execution must preserve the configured runner directory under the unprivileged service account.
requiredBehavior: execute the checksum-verified official runner dependency installer with UID 0
retain root ownership of a new extracted runner directory until dependency installation completes
transfer the new runner directory to the dedicated pcactions account only after dependency installation
preserve pcactions ownership when the already configured installer is executed again
reject a non-empty unconfigured runner directory instead of overwriting partial or untrusted contents
configure and run the GitHub Actions runner as the unprivileged pcactions account
fail contract validation when dependency installation is delegated through sudo -u to the runner user
preserve outbound-only transport labels and all read-only preflight boundaries
forbiddenCapabilities: production deployment or production data mutation
runner registration or REG.RU console mutation from CI
new server tunnel VPN provider SaaS subscription paid API or recurring cost
tenant role financial veterinary agronomic machinery repair or write-authority expansion
